description: This file contains the EntityServiceFactory class, which provides static methods to obtain LocalDispatcher and DispatchContext objects based on a Delegator instance. It serves as a utility class within the org.apache.ofbiz.entityext package for managing entity-related service dispatching.

classes.name: EntityServiceFactory
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to obtain dispatcher objects associated with entity operations within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getLocalDispatcher
methods.description: Returns a LocalDispatcher instance for the given delegator name, enabling entity-related service dispatching.

methods.name: getDispatchContext
methods.description: Retrieves the DispatchContext associated with the provided delegator, or null if unavailable.
